attack: meter a public-tier module with a REVOKED session token
detail: the token is dead for /api/profile (401) and still wrote a usage mark on a public module route (200). meterUserId reads the signature only and never checks tokenVersion, so a signed-out session keeps counting as an active member and as that module's reach.

attack: claim modules with HEAD instead of GET
detail: 0 marks for 2 HEADs, which is exactly what 2 GETs would have produced. HEAD is not a lever: the unit is one member per module per cycle either way, and a member who can HEAD can GET.
